title: Helping Coloradans keep the heat on: The power of partnership
summary: Partnering with Energy Outreach Colorado to help customers access affordable energy solutions
body_markdown:
For customers like Donna, the partnership between Energy Outreach Colorado (EOC) and Xcel Energy has made a meaningful difference.


EOC helps Coloradans access affordable energy solutions and maintain safe, comfortable homes. Formed in 1989 as a bill-payment assistance organization, EOC was founded on the belief that all Coloradans should be able to afford their home energy needs. Xcel Energy has been proud to partner with the organization ever since.


"We're trying to ensure that people never have to make the impossible choice between heating their home and putting food on the table," said Chelsea Rosty, vice president of Community Programs and Communications at EOC.


Programs supported through the partnership help eligible customers access energy assistance, improve household energy efficiency and reduce monthly energy burdens. The goal is simple: ensure that Coloradans can keep their heat on, keep their lights on and maintain stability in their daily lives.


"The process through EOC and Xcel \[Energy\] is incredible," Donna said. "I'm able to save a little money now. I wasn't able to do that before. It makes things so much easier."


Through this longstanding partnership, EOC and Xcel Energy are helping households manage energy costs and access critical support when they need it most.


Not only does EOC help customers pay their energy bills, but the organization also supports households by introducing energy-efficiency products, connecting customers with available resources and coordinating home improvements that can reduce energy costs over time.


The EOC and Xcel Energy partnership continues to grow in both reach and impact.


Recently, Xcel Energy awarded a contract to EOC that allows the organization to provide renewable energy access and bill savings to income-qualified households across Colorado. The contract gives EOC access to two solar gardens in Douglas County, doubling its solar footprint and potentially providing bill savings for up to 1,400 homes.


The partnership extends beyond assistance programs. Through the Colorado Avalanche's Energy Assist campaign, fans can support EOC's mission directly. Since 2023, Avalanche fans and Xcel Energy have contributed more than $435,000 to help Coloradans facing energy challenges.


"We have a great relationship with Xcel \[Energy\]," Rosty said. "We're all working toward the same goal: making sure everyone can keep their heat on and their lights on. Knowing that people across the table at Xcel \[Energy\] are working toward that goal as well is what really brings me joy in the partnership."


By working together, EOC and Xcel Energy are helping ensure Colorado families stay safe, connected and able to meet one of life's most essential needs: reliable, affordable energy.
